finalText:
Rule written and validated.

**File:** `/private/var/folders/11/m_kwnqr97632l_cjt0mhytvh0000gn/T/pstack-two-live-yVD7UN/agent/pstack-two/pstack-models.mdc` (`~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`, `alwaysApply: true`)

**Budget:** `large (xhigh)`

**Result** — all 17 roles, mapping shape kept from the skill defaults:

| Role line | Value |
|---|---|
| feature, refactoring / bug-fix / perf-issue / hillclimb | `inherit-parent` |
| judgment and prose / hardest tasks | `inherit-parent` |
| how explorer / how explainer | `inherit-parent` |
| why investigators / why synthesizer | `inherit-parent` |
| reflect tooling / reflect judgment, divergent, synthesizer | `inherit-parent` |
| swarm workers | `inherit-parent` |
| arena runners / architect runners / interrogate reviewers | `inherit-parent, inherit-parent` |
| arena cross-judge pool | `inherit-parent, inherit-parent` |

**Why everything inherits:** the detected Task model set is `openai/*`, `zai/glm-*`, `deepseek/*` only — there is no `grok-*` and no `claude-*` model in it. The skill's defaults are exclusively `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` and `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh`, so no role has a same-family model to fall to, and your fallback (`else inherit-parent`) applies to all of them. No unavailable real slug was written; only the always-valid alias. Panel lines keep two entries so their fan-out (2 runners/reviewers) is unchanged.

**Notes:** the rule takes effect in new sessions; re-running `/setup-pstack` updates it. The project here is an empty git repo with no `verify-*` skill or app harness, so if you later want agents to prove changes against the real app, `/create-verification-skill` can generate a project-local one. If you'd rather map the Grok/Judgment roles onto available families (e.g. `zai/glm-5.3` / `openai/gpt-5.3-codex` at `xhigh` for the code roles, `openai/gpt-5.5-pro` at `xhigh` for judgment), say the word and I'll rewrite the lines.
